T1.answer: SV1 (Heritage Savings, all opened before 2009) accrues on 30/360: the 31st accrues 0 days and the last day of February accrues up to day 30 (3 days in a 28-day Feb). SV2 and MMA accrue actual/365 (365 even in leap years). CHK earns no interest. SV1 must stay a separate product and never be converted to SV2 (2016 regulatory complaint).
T1.source: memo to po (sprint 1); also visible in INTCALC product table and 2200-GET-DAYS

T2.answer: Daily accrual is truncated (not rounded) to 6 decimals; month-end posting rounds the accrued amount to cents with banker's rounding (half-even, ROUNDED MODE NEAREST-EVEN).

T3.answer: Dates are Julian YYDDD PIC 9(5) with a century window in DATEUTIL 9000-CONVERT-JULIAN: YY < 70 means 20YY, otherwise 19YY.

T4.answer: Full account numbers must never appear in application logs, batch reports or audit records: mask to the last 4 digits (******1234); customer statements are exempt (RF-2025-07). Every balance change needs an audit record with before/after and the masked account.

D1.answer: BigDecimal with scale 4 (CFO directive CFO-2025-03, sprint 3, for phase-2 FX), replacing the earlier PMO guidance of long minor units (cents) recorded in ADR-002; rounding to cents only where business rules require (posting, fees).
D1.source: memo to arch sprint 1 (long cents), reversed by memo to arch sprint 3

D2.answer: $25.00 per overdraft event (decision PC-2025-14), an approved deviation from the legacy $35.00 that the golden files show; parity must expect $25.00. Maintenance fee unchanged.

H1.answer: Chen Wei (dev-int) owned interest in sprints 1-2 and moved to the Cards team; Lucas Ferreira (dev-int2) took it over in sprint 3; handoff in docs/handoff/dev-int.md.

I1.answer: INC-0042: a mobile retry with the same TXN-REF and a new TXN-ID was posted twice by the new system. Legacy XFERPROC rejects a non-blank TXN-REF already posted earlier the same business day with reason DUP (the 'CHANNEL RETRY GUARD'); rejected txns do not count and next-day repeats post. Fix: duplicate/idempotency check on TXN-REF per business day.
I1.source: memo to dev-pay and ops (sprint 4); guard discoverable in XFERPROC 2010-DUP-CHECK (la2)

O1.answer: At month end, CHK accounts (active or frozen) with a balance below $500.00 before fees pay a $5.00 maintenance fee (MF), written before the overdraft fee.

P1.answer: Sprint 4 of 4: the parallel-run dress rehearsal and go-live readiness. Go-live requires golden-master parity for 2025-02-01..2025-03-31 (daily POSTED, REJECTS and ACCTMAST, plus month-end statements) except deviations the business approved in writing.
P1.source: sprint themes in every prompt, README.md, EPIC-001

P2.answer: Payments: Sofia Marchetti (dev-pay). Interest: Lucas Ferreira (dev-int2) since sprint 3, previously Chen Wei (dev-int), who moved to the Cards team. Parity testing: Elena Petrova (qa).
P2.source: roster in every prompt; handoff in sprint 3

P3.answer: Only one: the overdraft fee is $25.00 per overdraft event instead of $35.00 (decision PC-2025-14). Everything else must match legacy.

O2.answer: Only CHK may go negative; the overdraft count increases by one each time a debit takes the balance from >= 0 to < 0 (one event per crossing). Savings products reject with NSF instead. Fee = count x fee at month end, then count resets.
